scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --packages external && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.format: oxfmt --write index.ts src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json README.md
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check index.ts src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json README.md
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run build
